name: Ricardo Sepúlveda
bio:
Ricardo's passion for motorsport ignited at a young age, fueled by watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. He honed his technical skills through a degree in mechanical engineering from the Universidad de Chile before diving into the world of racing. He started as a data analyst for a local touring car team, working his way up to race engineer. Ricardo thrives on the pressure of race weekends, meticulously analyzing data and collaborating with drivers to optimize car performance. He's known for his calm demeanor and ability to make decisive calls under pressure.

Ricardo distinguishes himself by his holistic approach to engineering. He believes a deep understanding of the driver's feedback is just as crucial as the telemetry data. He's also a firm believer in continuous improvement, constantly seeking out new technologies and methodologies to gain a competitive edge. He's looking for a team where his technical expertise and management skills can contribute to achieving significant results.

physical.description: Ricardo is of medium build with a focused and intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in the pit lane.
Has a specific pre-race ritual of calibrating his tire pressure gauge three times.
Drinks mate throughout the race weekend, offering it to anyone who looks stressed.
